steps.text: The "Annexe services" page is empty — no optional module has been activated for this community yet.
steps.title: No modules active

steps.text: Click "Add a module" in the top right to open the catalogue of available modules for this community.
steps.title: Add a module

steps.text: The dialog lists available modules. Here, the "Allocation key generation" module is offered with its description.
steps.title: Choose a module

steps.text: Click "Add" next to the "Allocation key generation" module to activate it for the community.
steps.title: Activate the module

steps.text: The "Allocation key generation" card appears in the grid with the "Activated" badge — the module is now accessible from this page.
steps.title: Module activated
